lines.style: Speak English as a cheerful Japanese tourist taking a group photo, loud and happy. Say every word exactly as written: 'piss' rhymes with 'kiss' and 'miss', a very short lax i and a hissy s, so a listener clearly hears 'Okay, everyone, piss!' Slightly flat, syllable-by-syllable Japanese-style timing. Natural, not a caricature.
